`fast-parse` is still pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json` — exactly the version `NOTES.md` says was yanked for a prototype-pollution bug, with `1.4.3` sitting right there as the fix.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — no auth on `/internal/metrics` and `/internal/flush-cache`, wide open since the VPN was dropped.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL injection via string-built `WHERE`/`ORDER BY` clauses.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — a real staging DB password committed in plain text.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked `1.4.2`, needs `1.4.3`.

No service code was touched, just the new `AUDIT.md`.
